G001.target_statement: Plan flight itineraries using travel websites.

G002.target_statement: Find the best available travel alternative considering price, seating and other benefits.

G003.target_statement: Obtain a good deal on flight bookings.

G004.target_statement: Aim to book flights at least one to one-and-a-half months ahead for a better price, ideally a couple of months ahead.

G005.target_statement: Book flights for friends and family as well as for oneself.

G006.target_statement: Use spare points or gift vouchers to help others save on their flights.

G007.target_statement: Prefer to maximize enjoyable time in the air when the trip and practical constraints permit.

G008.target_statement: Compare flight deals across multiple websites at intervals before booking.

G009.target_statement: Travel during the winter break, returning home if a good deal is found and otherwise choosing another destination.

G010.target_statement: Explore alternative city or country pairs, nearby airports and dates to find suitable options.

G011.target_statement: Coordinate the flight itinerary with onward transport and lodging logistics to avoid long unproductive waits.

G012.target_statement: Check provider coupon and upgrade options before deciding where to book.

G013.target_statement: Verify terminal and other journey logistics before booking.

G014.target_statement: Pay the selected booking through a credit card after finalizing the itinerary and provider.

G015.target_statement: Reach the selected provider's itinerary page with flight details already populated.

G016.target_statement: Prefer to search revenue flights anonymously without logging in, except when a specific need forces login.

G017.target_statement: Avoid disclosing personal data or being tracked while researching flights.

G018.target_statement: Check availability of limited award seats by logging into the airline loyalty account when making a points booking.

G019.target_statement: Book award flights directly with the airline account holding the points.

G020.target_statement: Search combinations of airports using country or region inputs instead of only the nearest airport.

G021.target_statement: Restrict departure and arrival times when connecting to another commitment.

G022.target_statement: Apply a reasonable flight-duration limit when a hard limit is needed, especially for international journeys.

G023.target_statement: Prefer international flight options balancing price and time rather than extremely long cheapest itineraries.

G024.target_statement: Compare the cheapest domestic options when the limited alternatives can be judged directly.

G025.target_statement: Find an itinerary whose connections and times fit the traveller's actual plans.

G026.target_statement: Compare provider final prices, ratings and applicable discounts for a chosen itinerary.

G027.target_statement: Recheck available alternatives when an itinerary is unsuitable, while accepting the only feasible urgent booking if necessary.

G028.target_statement: Prefer a reasonably priced flight arriving early enough to catch the last onward train and get home that night.

G029.target_statement: Receive price-drop alerts for several acceptable routes when urgent travel becomes too expensive.

G030.target_statement: Avoid sharing data with an additional party when an already-logged-in trusted-as-needed alternative can supply alerts.

G031.target_statement: Research many combinations of airports, dates, travellers and service classes at the same time.

G032.target_statement: Compare a broad combination of US and Indian airports, outbound and return date ranges and service classes, including a separate points search.

G033.target_statement: Find the best booking price for the selected itinerary across booking options.

G034.target_statement: Include flexibility when evaluating flight options, while giving itinerary and price greater emphasis.

G035.target_statement: Show price comparisons with typical market prices when the traveller is unfamiliar with that market.

G036.target_statement: Match flight timing to the schedule of the person being visited when relevant.

G037.target_statement: Prefer a flight time allowing a night's sleep, while accepting red-eye flights.

G038.target_statement: Prefer stopover time of at least about 1.5 to 2 times the airport minimum connection time to account for delays.

G039.target_statement: Check whether desired airport lounges will be open during stopovers.

G040.target_statement: Maintain global lounge access through Priority Pass.

G041.target_statement: Ideally integrate an up-to-date record of the traveller's cards and lounge entitlements with Skyscanner.

G042.target_statement: Check lounge access policies, opening times and disruptions using the relevant card or pass issuer's source.

G043.target_statement: For a limited-use lounge card, verify that airport access remains valid and unused allowance remains for the applicable period.

G044.target_statement: Obtain a set of booking partners potentially offering useful discounts or deals.

G045.target_statement: Find the best suitable flight option from all personal parameters in one place with less manual research.

G046.target_statement: Access the information needed for booking in one place instead of consulting at least ten to twelve sites.

G047.target_statement: Reduce time and mental effort spent performing repeated flight research.

G048.target_statement: Research flight options more accurately while spending less time.

G049.target_statement: Adopt a different research platform for even small recurring time savings over the long term.
